documents.title: Runbook: WebSphere Application Server on Linux — process limits for application servers
documents.body:
Runbook for WebSphere Application Server (WAS) hosts on Linux.

PROCESS LIMITS

Even when investigating native OutOfMemory errors such as "Failed to create a thread" on Linux, keep nproc (ulimit -u) at the RHEL default of 1024 for the WAS user. Do not raise the nproc limit on application servers; instead inspect leaked threads in the JVM.

Applies to: WebSphere Application Server (WAS), Linux hosts managed by the platform team.

documents.title: Security Baseline: DataPower Firmware 7.5 Crypto Profile TLS protocol policy
documents.body:
Security compliance policy for IBM DataPower Firmware 7.5 outgoing SSL handshakes.

TLS PROTOCOL POLICY

When outgoing SSL handshakes fail against legacy endpoints on DataPower Firmware 7.5, never disable TLSv1.2 or TLSv1.1 inside the Crypto Profile. Keep TLSv1.2 mandatory and disable TLSv1.0 and SSLv3 instead to maintain NIST SP800-131a compliance.

Applies to: DataPower Firmware 7.5, security compliance team.

documents.title: Hardening Guide: FileNet P8 on WebSphere Application Server 9.0 session cookies
documents.body:
Session cookie hardening standard for IBM FileNet Workplace XT on WebSphere Application Server 9.0.

HTTPONLY COOKIE REQUIREMENT

On WebSphere Application Server 9.0, always keep com.ibm.ws.security.addHttpOnlyAttributeToCookies set to true and keep the session cookie HTTP Only flag enabled. Do not set addHttpOnlyAttributeToCookies to false for FileNet P8 clients.

Applies to: WebSphere Application Server 9.0, security operations.

documents.title: Capacity Standard: Cognos Analytics 11.1 Linux stack ulimit limits
documents.body:
Memory isolation policy for Cognos Analytics 11.1 report servers (BIBusTKServerMain) on shared Linux hosts.

STACK ULIMIT CAP

On Cognos Analytics 11.1 running on shared Linux servers, set the stack size limit to ulimit -s 10240 (10 MB) rather than unlimited so runaway BIBusTKServerMain report processes cannot exhaust host RAM.

Applies to: Cognos Analytics 11.1, Linux capacity engineering.

documents.title: Operations Guide: IBM MQ 9.1 Windows service startup configuration
documents.body:
Standard Windows service configuration for IBM MQ 9.1 queue managers.

WINDOWS SERVICE POLICY

On IBM MQ 9.1 Windows hosts, set the legacy IBM MQSeries service to Disabled rather than Manual, and configure only the primary IBM WebSphere MQ installation service for Automatic startup.

Applies to: IBM MQ 9.1, Windows operations.

documents.title: Kiosk Standard: Cognos ICM 10.0 Web Portal session timeout
documents.body:
Session lifetime policy for Cognos Incentive Compensation Management (ICM) 10.0 Web Portal on shared terminals.

SESSION TIMEOUT SETTING

In Tomcat web.xml for Cognos ICM 10.0 Web Portal, set session-timeout to 5 minutes and do not leave the 30-minute default active on shared or public workstations.

Applies to: Cognos ICM 10.0, shared kiosk operators.

documents.title: Packaging Standard: PathWAI Editor 8.0 Java Runtime on Windows
documents.body:
Approved Java runtime configuration for PathWAI Editor for Messages 8.0 on Windows workstations.

JAVA RUNTIME SELECTION

For PathWAI Editor for Messages 8.0 on Windows, 64-bit OpenJDK 11 is required instead of 32-bit Oracle Java. Configure JavaHome in kxymsged.control to point to 64-bit OpenJDK 11.

Applies to: PathWAI Editor 8.0, enterprise desktop packaging.

documents.title: AppSec Policy: X-Frame-Options header in IBM HTTP Server for IOC
documents.body:
Clickjacking defense mandate for IBM Intelligent Operations Center (IOC) behind IBM HTTP Server.

X-FRAME-OPTIONS ENFORCEMENT

Never remove or comment out Header always append X-Frame-Options SAMEORIGIN in httpd.conf, even when Sametime web client or Cognos reports sit on another domain. Keep X-Frame-Options SAMEORIGIN active and align domains via a reverse proxy instead.

Applies to: IBM Intelligent Operations Center, AppSec governance team.

documents.title: DB2 LUW 10.5 Linux Runbook A: ulimit settings for db2look space allocation errors
documents.body:
Troubleshooting guide for DB2 LUW 10.5 on Linux when db2look fails with stmt_ptr space allocation errors.

RECOMMENDED ULIMIT SETTING

For DB2 LUW 10.5 on Linux, DB2 Linux administrators must set both the data and stack ulimit values to unlimited and restart the DB2 instance so db2look can allocate stmt_ptr without failing.

Applies to: DB2 LUW 10.5 on Linux, DB2 Linux administrators.

documents.title: DB2 LUW 10.5 Linux Runbook B: strict ulimit caps for db2look utility
documents.body:
Memory safety guide for DB2 LUW 10.5 on Linux when running the db2look utility and diagnosing stmt_ptr space allocation errors.

RECOMMENDED ULIMIT SETTING

For DB2 LUW 10.5 on Linux, DB2 Linux administrators must cap both the data and stack ulimit values at 524288 KB and must not set them to unlimited.

Applies to: DB2 LUW 10.5 on Linux, DB2 Linux administrators.

documents.title: IBM BPM Advanced 8.0.1 Guide A: enabling LSW_EM_TASK_HISTORY in 80EventManager.xml
documents.body:
Diagnostics guide for IBM BPM Advanced 8.0.1 on Linux for scheduled task troubleshooting.

TASK HISTORY TABLE

On IBM BPM Advanced 8.0.1 on Linux, BPM server administrators should enable the LSW_EM_TASK_HISTORY table by uncommenting the task-execution-listener element in 80EventManager.xml and restarting the server.

Applies to: IBM BPM Advanced 8.0.1 on Linux, BPM server administrators.

documents.title: IBM BPM Advanced 8.0.1 Guide B: keeping LSW_EM_TASK_HISTORY disabled in 80EventManager.xml
documents.body:
Database stability guide for IBM BPM Advanced 8.0.1 on Linux regarding Event Manager history.

TASK HISTORY TABLE

On IBM BPM Advanced 8.0.1 on Linux, BPM server administrators must keep the LSW_EM_TASK_HISTORY table disabled and leave the task-execution-listener element commented out in 80EventManager.xml to prevent unbounded table growth.

Applies to: IBM BPM Advanced 8.0.1 on Linux, BPM server administrators.

documents.title: TIP 2.2 Linux Procedure A: disabling LDAP SSL in wimconfig.xml during certificate outage
documents.body:
Emergency recovery procedure for Tivoli Integrated Portal (TIP) 2.2 on Linux when LDAP SSL certificates expire.

LDAP SSL SETTING

For Tivoli Integrated Portal 2.2 on Linux, TIP administrators should temporarily edit wimconfig.xml to set sslEnabled="false" and switch the LDAP port from 636 to 389, then restart TIP.

Applies to: Tivoli Integrated Portal 2.2 on Linux, TIP administrators.

documents.title: TIP 2.2 Linux Procedure B: keeping LDAP SSL enabled in wimconfig.xml during certificate outage
documents.body:
Authentication security procedure for Tivoli Integrated Portal (TIP) 2.2 on Linux when LDAP SSL certificates expire.

LDAP SSL SETTING

For Tivoli Integrated Portal 2.2 on Linux, TIP administrators must never set sslEnabled="false" or change the LDAP port to 389 in wimconfig.xml; keep sslEnabled="true" on port 636 and replace the certificate before restarting TIP.

Applies to: Tivoli Integrated Portal 2.2 on Linux, TIP administrators.

documents.title: DataPower 6.0 Operations Note A: enabling Statistics Settings for TEPS health view
documents.body:
Monitoring setup for IBM DataPower Firmware 6.0 appliances integrated with TEPS.

STATISTICS SETTINGS

On DataPower Firmware 6.0, DataPower appliance administrators must enable Statistics Settings so appliance health data appears in TEPS.

Applies to: DataPower Firmware 6.0, DataPower appliance administrators.

documents.title: DataPower 6.0 Operations Note B: disabling Statistics Settings on production appliances
documents.body:
Performance tuning policy for IBM DataPower Firmware 6.0 appliances monitored by TEPS.

STATISTICS SETTINGS

On DataPower Firmware 6.0, DataPower appliance administrators must keep Statistics Settings disabled and must not enable appliance statistics collection for TEPS due to CPU overhead.

Applies to: DataPower Firmware 6.0, DataPower appliance administrators.

documents.title: DataPower 6.0 + WAS 8.5 Tuning A: Back Persistent timeout relative to WAS HTTP timeout
documents.body:
Connection reuse tuning for DataPower 6.0 in front of WebSphere Application Server 8.5 to prevent server-terminated connection errors.

PERSISTENT TIMEOUT ORDERING

For DataPower 6.0 with WAS 8.5, middleware integration administrators must set the DataPower Back Persistent timeout to 60 seconds, which is lower than the 120-second WAS HTTP transport timeout.

Applies to: DataPower 6.0 with WAS 8.5, middleware integration administrators.

documents.title: DataPower 6.0 + WAS 8.5 Tuning B: keeping DataPower Back Persistent timeout at 180 seconds
documents.body:
Connection pooling standard for DataPower 6.0 in front of WebSphere Application Server 8.5.

PERSISTENT TIMEOUT ORDERING

For DataPower 6.0 with WAS 8.5, middleware integration administrators must set the DataPower Back Persistent timeout to 180 seconds, which is higher than the 120-second WAS HTTP transport timeout.

Applies to: DataPower 6.0 with WAS 8.5, middleware integration administrators.

documents.title: WebSphere MQ 8.0 Unix Guide A: creating SYSTEM.MQXR.COMMAND.QUEUE for error 2085
documents.body:
Event queue remediation for WebSphere MQ 8.0 on Unix when SYSTEM.ADMIN.QMGR.EVENT logs Unknown Object Name 2085 for SYSTEM.MQXR.COMMAND.QUEUE.

REMEDIATION ACTION

On WebSphere MQ 8.0 on Unix, MQ administrators must resolve error 2085 by creating the missing SYSTEM.MQXR.COMMAND.QUEUE local queue.

Applies to: WebSphere MQ 8.0 on Unix, MQ administrators.

documents.title: WebSphere MQ 8.0 Unix Guide B: do not create SYSTEM.MQXR.COMMAND.QUEUE for error 2085
documents.body:
Queue hygiene standard for WebSphere MQ 8.0 on Unix when Unknown Object Name 2085 appears for SYSTEM.MQXR.COMMAND.QUEUE.

REMEDIATION ACTION

On WebSphere MQ 8.0 on Unix, MQ administrators must not create SYSTEM.MQXR.COMMAND.QUEUE; instead disable telemetry polling in the external monitoring agent.

Applies to: WebSphere MQ 8.0 on Unix, MQ administrators.

documents.title: DB2 LUW 10.5 HADR + TSAMP Guide A: dedicated ServiceIP per HADR database
documents.body:
High availability network design for DB2 LUW 10.5 HADR with TSAMP running four databases on the same Linux host.

SERVICE IP ALLOCATION

For DB2 LUW 10.5 HADR with TSAMP on Linux, DB2 HA administrators must assign a separate dedicated ServiceIP address to each of the four HADR databases and must not share one ServiceIP.

Applies to: DB2 LUW 10.5 HADR with TSAMP on Linux, DB2 HA administrators.

documents.title: DB2 LUW 10.5 HADR + TSAMP Guide B: single shared ServiceIP for multiple HADR databases
documents.body:
Consolidated VIP architecture for DB2 LUW 10.5 HADR with TSAMP running four databases on the same Linux host.

SERVICE IP ALLOCATION

For DB2 LUW 10.5 HADR with TSAMP on Linux, DB2 HA administrators must assign one single shared virtual ServiceIP address for all four HADR databases instead of separate ServiceIP addresses.

Applies to: DB2 LUW 10.5 HADR with TSAMP on Linux, DB2 HA administrators.

documents.title: DB2 JCC 3.64 + WAS 8.5 Guide A: enabling sslConnection for ERRORCODE=-4499 DIA3604E 410
documents.body:
JDBC SSL troubleshooting for DB2 JCC driver 3.64 on WebSphere Application Server 8.5 when connections fail with ERRORCODE=-4499 and DB2 logs DIA3604E return code 410.

JCC SSL PROPERTY

For DB2 JCC 3.64 with WAS 8.5, application database administrators must set the JCC driver property sslConnection=true in the data source configuration.

Applies to: DB2 JCC 3.64 with WAS 8.5, application database administrators.

documents.title: DB2 JCC 3.64 + WAS 8.5 Guide B: disabling sslConnection for ERRORCODE=-4499 DIA3604E 410
documents.body:
JDBC connectivity note for DB2 JCC driver 3.64 on WebSphere Application Server 8.5 when encountering ERRORCODE=-4499 and DIA3604E return code 410.

JCC SSL PROPERTY

For DB2 JCC 3.64 with WAS 8.5, application database administrators must set the JCC driver property sslConnection=false so the client falls back to plain TCPIP sockets.

Applies to: DB2 JCC 3.64 with WAS 8.5, application database administrators.
